name: Zeal
overview: Scripture presents zeal as a powerful and commendable force when directed toward God and His purposes, exemplified by Phinehas whose zeal turned away God's wrath and secured an everlasting priesthood (Numbers 25:11,13). King Josiah demonstrated zeal for the Lord by purging idolatry from Judah, destroying objects and priests associated with false worship (2 Kings 23:4,5). Yet zeal can also be misdirected, as seen in Saul's misguided zeal against the Gibeonites (2 Samuel 21:2). True zeal, therefore, is characterized by fervent devotion to God that leads to righteous action and the defense of His honor (2 Kings 10:16).
